metadata.description: AI video generation and editing for Claude, via the Clipwave MCP server.

plugins.name: clipwave
plugins.description: Generate video and images, then cut them together on a real multi-track timeline — Claude drives the whole edit and exports an MP4.

plugins.name: logo-maker
plugins.description: AI logo generator and brand designer: describe your brand and get up to four logo concepts (PNG) in an interactive panel, then refine them in your ManyMotions account.

plugins.name: clipwave-video-image-maker
plugins.description: AI video generator and AI image generator: turn a text prompt into images and videos (text to image, text to video), choose model, ratio, resolution and duration in a panel, and render in your ManyMotions account.

plugins.name: ugc-video-ads
plugins.description: AI UGC video ad maker: turn a product brief into a short UGC-style video ad for TikTok, Reels and Shorts with an AI presenter and voice, delivered as an MP4 from your ManyMotions account.
